title: Ref callbacks for a list of nodes

slides.say: You need a ref to each item in a list, but you do not know how many items there will be.
You cannot call use ref inside map. Hooks must be called at the top level.
Instead, pass a function to the ref attribute. React calls it with the DOM node, and calls the returned cleanup when it is time to clear it. Keep the nodes in a Map.

slides.text: One ref holding a Map: look up any node by ID later.
slides.say: Now one ref holds a Map of nodes, and you can look up any of them by its ID later.
